title: Correctness Conditioning as Selection in Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.37070v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Restricting chain-of-thought (CoT) faithfulness evaluation to correctly answered instances changes the population being measured. We study this selection step in a seven-variable structural causal model and derive the exact observed gap $\Delta = \operatorname{Cov}(A, C)/P(C=1)$. The model distinguishes difficulty confounding from shortcut-induced collider bias and states the conditional-independence assumption needed to express the gap through latent response propensities. A protocol review of 18 papers distinguishes answer-correctness restrictions from agreement-based selection, benchmark construction, and training-data filtering. We evaluate four sub-ceiling deployments on arithmetic tasks and observe positive selection gaps in all four. The primary GLM-5.3 run yields a +7.4 percentage-point gap ($n = 1000$, $p < 0.0001$), and pooled Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel analysis gives OR = 1.70 ($p < 10^{-6}$). translated_title: 正确性条件化作为思维链忠实性评估中的选择机制
translated_abstract: 将思维链忠实性评估限制在回答正确的实例上会改变被测量的总体。我们在一个七变量结构因果模型中研究这一选择步骤，并推导出精确的观测差距 Δ = Cov(A, C)/P(C=1)。该模型区分了难度混淆与捷径引起的对撞机偏差，并阐述了通过潜在响应倾向表达该差距所需的条件独立性假设。对18篇论文的协议综述区分了答案正确性限制与基于一致性选择、基准构建以及训练数据过滤。我们在算术任务上评估了四个低于上限的部署场景，并在全部四个场景中均观察到正向选择差距。主要的GLM-5.3运行产生了+7.4个百分点的差距（n = 1000，p < 0.0001），合并的Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel分析给出OR = 1.70（p < 10⁻⁶）。一种无假设的协方差分解……
tldr: 该研究通过结构因果模型揭示，在思维链忠实性评估中仅筛选回答正确的实例会引入选择偏差，导致测得的忠实性差距被系统性高估（在GLM-5.3上达+7.4个百分点）。
